lines.text: Sunday morning in Bishan. The Lim family is off to Gardens by the Bay.
But the haze is back. Mum opens Haze GoWhere. Live NEA readings put the PSI at two hundred and twenty-nine. Very unhealthy, and they have a toddler in tow.
She searches for Gardens by the Bay. The app scores every route by how many minutes you'd spend breathing outside air.
Its pick: the Circle Line, plus an indoor link. Twenty-six minutes protected, only eight exposed.
They tap Start navigation. A one-minute walk to Bishan station, the train to Bayfront, then the indoor link toward the Supertrees.
Haze GoWhere. Breathe easier, every trip.
